definitions: Used to express necessity or compulsion.
Used to express a strong recommendation or an obligation.
Used to express an assumption or a logical inference.
Used to express the inevitability of something.
examples: We must try that new restaurant.
All good things must come to an end.
pastTenses: no past tense form (used with 'had to' for past necessity), no past tense form (used with 'had to' for past necessity)
